objective: Remediate remaining gaps between Decision, Actor, Shadow, and Hardware across terminal transitions, water lifecycle, safety budget transactions, recipe synchronization, sensor freshness, and manual control safety.

acceptance.criterion: Terminal abort transitions clear active actors (DosingActor, WaterActor), reset peripheral shadow outputs (pump_status, osaka_pwm), and clear ownership flags across all system phases.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test actor_terminal_reset_tests and fsm_terminal_matrix_tests in hydragrow-controller-core

acceptance.criterion: WaterActor owns its timeout and abort semantics, transitioning to Fault(WaterRefillFailed) or Fault(WaterDrainFailed) on phase timeout and resetting active actors.
MIMO dosing hard timeout stops all dosing pumps and Osaka mist/mix peripherals, and purges trailing ON events.
Water pump IN and OUT mutual exclusion is enforced across Decision, Context Delta Merge, and SystemContext Apply layers.
Safety budget transactions are staged during ticks and committed only upon verified physical actuator dispatch success.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test safety_budget_executable_tests in hydragrow-controller-core and sim_dispatcher in hydragrow-simulator

acceptance.criterion: Recipe execution identity includes id, revision, stage, and start time, resetting stage cursor and completion on revision bump.
Sensor freshness is tracked per channel, and disabled sensor channels do not trigger stale or NaN faults.
Manual dosing requests are clamped to server safety limits, and ESP32 force_on commands validate estimated dose against max_dose_per_cycle.
acceptance.verification: Cargo test api::control in hydragrow-backend and command_handler in ESP32 runtime

acceptance.criterion: Terminal commands (RebootDevice, FactoryReset) dispatch reliably even when preceding best-effort stop operations encounter actuator errors.
DosingActor is the single authority for pulse hardware events, preventing duplicate hardware emissions during pulse toggles.
acceptance.verification: Cargo clippy and unit tests in hydragrow-controller-core

acceptance.criterion: Controller configuration enforces cross-field validation rules for pH targets and water level hierarchy.
Full 18-case terminal transition regression matrix verifies Invariant I1 across all system phases and terminal triggers.
